title: LightCarbon LCG074S-D micro-suspension gravel frameset with stem
notes: Exact page identifies LCG074S-D and distinguishes its 140 g separate-stem package from LCG074-D. It supplies material, frame and fork weights, 50C/650B/29er clearance, micro-suspension pivot, storage, T47, UDH, geometry, ISO4210 and two-year warranty.
